definitions.gloss: exercise, use, exertion (of a right, power, or authority)
definitions.explanation: The act of putting a right, power, or authority into actual use or practice. A formal term used in legal, political, and institutional contexts. Implies the deliberate activation of something one is entitled to or capable of.

examples.japanese: {拒否権|きょひけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{行使|こうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To exercise the right of veto.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}に{応|おう}じて→必要に応じて：22822_hitsuyounioujite⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{行使|こうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The police can use force as necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{武力|ぶりょく}→武力：13221_buryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行使|こうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦あらゆる→あらゆる：03824_arayuru⟧⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くした→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧で⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: The use of military force must be a last resort, employed only after all diplomatic efforts have been exhausted.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term most commonly seen in legal, political, and diplomatic discourse. The object of {行使|こうし} is typically a right (⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧), power (⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧), or force (⟦{武力|ぶりょく}→武力：13221_buryoku⟧/⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧). Not used for casual, everyday actions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{行使|こうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise a right
- {拒否権|きょひけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{行使|こうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise veto power
- ⟦{武力|ぶりょく}→武力：13221_buryoku⟧{行使|こうし}: use of military force
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧{行使|こうし}: use of force, direct action
- ⟦{投票権|とうひょうけん}→投票権：27950_touhyouken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行使|こうし}: exercising one's right to vote
